fullPassage: Plant growth is controlled by a group of hormones called auxins found at the tips of stems and roots of plants. Auxins produced at the tips of stems tend to accumulate on the side of the stem that is in the shade. Accordingly, the auxins stimulate growth on the shaded side of the plant. Therefore, the shaded side grows faster than the side facing the sunlight. This phenomenon causes the stem to bend and appear to be growing towards the light. Auxins have the opposite effect on the roots of plants. Auxins in the tips of roots tend to limit growth. If a root is horizontal in the soil, the auxins will accumulate on the lower side and interfere with its development. Therefore, the lower side of the root will grow slower than the upper side. This will, in turn, cause the root to bend downwards, with the tip of the root growing in that direction.

❌ ② accumulate(축적되다) - prevent(막다) - faster(더 빠른): (B) prevent는 '막다'로, 성장을 촉진한다는 문맥에 반대
❌ ③ accumulate(축적되다) - stimulate(촉진하다) - slower(더 느린): (C) slower는 '더 느린'으로, 그늘진 쪽이 더 빨리 자란다는 문맥에 반대

questions.passage: Plant growth is controlled by a group of hormones called auxins found at the tips of stems and roots of plants. Auxins produced at the tips of stems tend to accumulate on the side of the stem that is in the shade. Accordingly, the auxins stimulate growth on the shaded side of the plant. Therefore, the shaded side grows faster than the side facing the sunlight. This phenomenon causes the stem to bend and appear to be growing __________. Auxins have the opposite effect on the roots of plants. Auxins in the tips of roots tend to limit growth. If a root is horizontal in the soil, the auxins will accumulate on the lower side and interfere with its development. Therefore, the lower side of the root will grow slower than the upper side. This will, in turn, cause the root to bend downwards, with the tip of the root growing in that direction.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빛을 향해(towards the light) 자라는 것처럼 보인다
det.analysis:
✅ ① towards the light: 줄기가 구부러져 빛을 향해 자라는 것처럼 보인다 ←정답
❌ ② into the soil: 흙 속으로는 뿌리의 방향
❌ ③ against the wind: 바람에 맞서는 표현은 본문에 없음
❌ ④ under the shade: 그늘 아래는 방향이 아닌 위치
det.tip: appear to be growing ______ → towards the light

questions.passage: Plant growth is controlled by a group of hormones called auxins found at the tips of stems and roots of plants. Auxins produced at the tips of stems tend to accumulate on the side of the stem that is in the shade. Accordingly, the auxins stimulate growth on the shaded side of the plant. Therefore, the shaded side grows faster than the side facing the sunlight. This phenomenon causes the stem to bend and appear to be growing towards the light. Auxins have __________ on the roots of plants. Auxins in the tips of roots tend to limit growth. If a root is horizontal in the soil, the auxins will accumulate on the lower side and interfere with its development. Therefore, the lower side of the root will grow slower than the upper side. This will, in turn, cause the root to bend downwards, with the tip of the root growing in that direction.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 옥신은 뿌리에 반대 효과(the opposite effect)를 준다
det.analysis:
❌ ① a positive influence: 긍정적 영향은 뒤의 '성장 제한'과 모순
✅ ② the opposite effect: 줄기와 달리 뿌리에는 반대 효과를 준다는 맥락 ←정답
❌ ③ the same result: 같은 결과는 opposite 문맥에 반대
❌ ④ no impact at all: 아무 영향 없다는 것은 뒤 문맥과 모순
det.tip: Auxins have ______ on the roots → the opposite effect
